items.title: 上线两月流水破2亿美元，《哈利波特：魔法觉醒》今日官宣停服
items.en_title: After $200M in Two Months, Harry Potter: Magic Awakened Announces Shutdown
items.en_oneliner: With its license agreement expiring, Harry Potter: Magic Awakened will stop top-ups and delist on December 21, 2026, and shut down its servers on March 3, 2027 — a reminder of the lifecycle risks behind licensed-IP games.

items.title: We almost got a medieval Call of Duty with knights and swords: 'If it's a war story, sure, it can be Call of Duty'
items.en_title: We almost got a medieval Call of Duty with knights and swords: 'If it's a war story, sure, it can be Call of Duty'
items.en_oneliner: Developers reveal a medieval Call of Duty with knights and swords was once on the table, since any war story can be a Call of Duty.

items.title: Make 100 NPCs for your game in 5 minutes (free, in the browser)
items.en_title: Make 100 NPCs for your game in 5 minutes (free, in the browser)
items.en_oneliner: No Blender, no paid asset packs: the author shows how to fill a game with unique characters in under five minutes using the free browser tool MOLD.

items.title: Two AI poker bots announced a full house. Only one had it.
items.en_title: Two AI poker bots announced a full house. Only one had it.
items.en_oneliner: On the author's AI poker site, language models play against old-school rule engines, and one hand exposes the real gap between them in reading cards and bluffing.

items.title: Creating SD versions of @2x osu! skin files with Python and Pillow (without dark edges)
items.en_title: Creating SD versions of @2x osu! skin files with Python and Pillow (without dark edges)
items.en_oneliner: For osu! skins drawn only at high resolution, the author shares a Python script that batch-generates SD versions without the dark edges downsampling usually causes.

items.title: Intel are being sued for "misleading" investors about "a massive glut of unwanted PC inventory" thanks to AI-fuelled price hikes
items.en_title: Intel are being sued for "misleading" investors about "a massive glut of unwanted PC inventory" thanks to AI-fuelled price hikes
items.en_oneliner: Intel faces a class action for allegedly misleading investors about how generative AI-driven component price hikes hit PC sales and left a glut of unwanted inventory.

items.title: Biostar announces the first Intel Panther Lake motherboard and it's tiny, but don't get your hopes up for cramming it into a mini gaming PC
items.en_title: Biostar announces the first Intel Panther Lake motherboard and it's tiny, but don't get your hopes up for cramming it into a mini gaming PC
items.en_oneliner: The first Panther Lake motherboard is here and tiny, but with only four Xe3 cores on the G3 chip, a mini gaming PC build looks unlikely.

items.title: PixiJS Moves Into 3D – PixiJS 3D
items.en_oneliner: PixiJS, the popular 2D WebGL and WebGPU framework, has moved into 3D, opening it up to developers using engines like GDevelop and RPG Maker.

items.title: 《足球经理》熬了两年，总算重归正轨
items.en_title: Football Manager Fought Through Two Rough Years and Is Finally Back on Track
items.en_oneliner: After switching to Unity, a cancelled FM25 and a rocky FM26, a conversation with the FM27 team on how the series is finding its footing again.
